question_text:
Which revision best streamlines this DOH administrative order to eliminate redundancy?

"The Department of Health hereby orders and directs that all regional offices must comply and adhere to the new guidelines and regulations effective immediately and without delay."

A. The Department of Health orders that all regional offices comply with the new guidelines effective immediately.
B. The Department of Health hereby orders and directs that all regional offices must comply and adhere to the new guidelines and regulations effective immediately and without delay.
C. The Department of Health directs that all regional offices must adhere to the new regulations effective without delay.
D. The Department of Health orders that all regional offices must comply with the new guidelines effective immediately and without delay.

options.text: The Department of Health orders that all regional offices comply with the new guidelines effective immediately.
The Department of Health hereby orders and directs that all regional offices must comply and adhere to the new guidelines and regulations effective immediately and without delay.
The Department of Health directs that all regional offices must adhere to the new regulations effective without delay.
The Department of Health orders that all regional offices must comply with the new guidelines effective immediately and without delay.
